service__description--brake_pads: Replace pads, clean and lube slides, check fluid.
service__description--brake_rotors: Replace rotors on the axle; pairs well with new pads.
service__description--suspension: Replace struts or shocks on the axle. An alignment afterwards is recommended and not included.
service__description--oil_change: Drain, new oil filter, fresh oil, and a quick fluid and tire check.
service__description--spark_plugs: Most 4-cylinder engines. V6/V8 or plugs under the intake may need a custom quote.
service__description--alternator: Remove and replace the alternator, test charging output.
service__description--air_filter: Engine air filter; cabin filter on request.
service__description--other: Describe the problem and I'll let you know if it's something I can take on.
bundle__description--pads_rotors: Rotors come off anyway when pads are replaced, so the second job is mostly free time.
bundle__description--brakes_suspension: The wheel and caliper are already off, so suspension work on the same axle goes faster.
